text:
Elaine: Quick heads-up — we're scheduling a slim-image rollup next Tue to remove unused layers and switch to the compact runtime base. Need to coordinate RBAC for image-puller, KMS key rotation for signed manifests, and bump audit retention. Who can take RBAC + PR? 

Jamal: I can own RBAC bindings. Which services are in-scope? 

Elaine: Start with api-gateway, runner, and batch-workers. We'll probably add others after the first canary. 

Jamal: OK. Quick image list cmd to scope:
```
gcloud artifacts docker images list --repository=projects/redwood/artifacts/repo
```

Maria: FYI we need vuln triage before canary — I'll run quick scans and flag any blocking CVEs. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/vuln-triage :eyes:

Alan: KMS note — current key is projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/key-prod-01. Rotation will require re-signing manifests. Suggest pre-sign + cosign. Example:
```
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/infra/.../cryptoKeys/key-prod-01 ghcr.io/redwood/base:compact-202603
```

devops-oncall: Canary window available Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. I'll be on standby. If we see regressions, rollback tag to `base-2026-02-10`. I'll open the rollback runbook if needed. :warning:

security-bot: Audit retention increased to 365d for images/audit in config; logs forwarding to splunk-audit confirmed. Will emit a config change event when PR merges. 

Jamal: I'll open the IAM PR today and add reviewers (cc @maria). Plan: jamal -> RBAC PR, alan -> cosign + re-sign script, elaine -> release notes + security advisory, devops-oncall -> canary ops. :white_check_mark:

Maria: Adding quick vuln scan script to repo:
```
./scripts/quick-vuln-scan.sh ghcr.io/redwood/base:compact-202603
```
I'll post results in #security-qa.

Elaine: Filing tracking ticket SEC-4220 and schedule sync Mon 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT. Thanks — please add blockers to the ticket. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2291 as a placeholder if canary fails. 

Alan: One more — we should capture image manifest signatures as artifacts in the release job. Will add to CI. 

devops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll reserve the canary slot and add pager rotation. 

Elaine: Great. Reconvene Monday with PR links and vuln scan output. Thanks everyone.
